description_en: Creates a premium bandwidth plan for an office network
description_zh: 为办公网络创建一个公网精品带宽
name: CreateNetworkPackage

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the premium bandwidth plan. Unit: Mbit/s.    

If the premium bandwidth plan uses the subscription billing method, the valid values are 2 to 1000.
If the premium bandwidth plan uses the pay-as-you-go billing method and the metering method is pay-by-data-transfer (PayByTraffic), the valid values are 2 to 200.
If the premium bandwidth plan uses the pay-as-you-go billing method and the metering method is pay-by-bandwidth (PayByBandwidth), the valid values are 2 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
公网精品带宽的带宽大小。单位：Mbps。    

如果是包年包月精品带宽，则取值范围是2\~1000。
如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按使用流量计费（PayByTraffic），则取值范围是2\~200；
如果是按量付费精品带宽，且类型是按固定带宽计费（PayByBandwidth），则取值范围是2\~1000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The billable methods of the premium bandwidth plan.

When the parameter `PayType` is set to `PrePaid`, the valid value is:
    - PayByBandwidth: billing by fixed bandwidth.
When the parameter `PayType` is set to `PostPaid`, the valid values are:
    - PayByTraffic: billing by data transfer.
    - PayByBandwidth: billing by fixed bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
公网精品带宽的计费方式。

当参数`PayType`取值为`PrePaid`时，取值范围：
    - PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
当参数`PayType`取值为`PostPaid`时，取值范围：
    - PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费。
    - PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the premium bandwidth plan. This parameter takes effect and is required only when PayType is set to PrePaid. Valid values are determined by the PeriodUnit parameter.

If PeriodUnit is set to Week, the valid value is 1.
If PeriodUnit is set to Month, the valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.
If PeriodUnit is set to Year, the valid values are 1, 2, and 3.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月精品带宽的购买时长。当参数`PayType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

`PeriodUnit`为`Week`时，取值范围为：1。
`PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。
`PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1、2、3。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration for the premium bandwidth plan. This parameter takes effect and is required only when PayType is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh: 包年包月精品带宽的购买时长单位。当参数`PayType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The user ID of resource ownership in the reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter if you are not using the reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

parameters.help_en: This field is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 此字段暂不对外开放使用
parameters.name: channel_cookie

fields.help_en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. A maximum of 20 tags are supported
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
